purpose: User approved personal left sidebar line drawing, experimental source asset for private user upload.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: personal sidebar line drawing, tall portrait 2:3 PNG with genuine transparent alpha background, displayed about 200 pixels wide in lower part of a dark teal #1d424e application sidebar.
User inspiration: sci-fi, technology and AI; rivers and beaches.
Primary request: Delicate sparse monochrome line art of a winding river flowing to a coast, with distant graceful futuristic spires. Thin warm off-white and very subtle pale cyan strokes only. Elegant economical contours suggest riverbanks, a few coastal rocks, gentle waves and three slender architectural forms.
Style/medium: refined hand-drawn architectural landscape line illustration, minimal contour drawing. NO filled scene. Lines remain legible when reduced to 200 pixels wide.
Composition: tall portrait; drawing concentrated in lower half and along lower edges, river curves downward toward lower edge, small distant spires near lower-middle left. Upper third almost entirely empty transparent space; sparse strokes taper upward with generous transparent negative space between all shapes. Entire artwork quietly accents a sidebar without interfering with navigation labels.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no opaque rectangle, no background colour, no black/white backdrop, no drawn checkerboard. No heavy filled forms, no shading, no gradients filling surfaces, no photorealism, no 3D render, no text, no logos, no people, no robots, no border. Pure fine warm off-white and pale cyan linework suspended on transparency.
visualInspection: Fine coastal and futuristic contours concentrated below center with empty upper area; output also includes a broad luminous haze behind lower linework. Consumer should inspect on dark teal before accepting as pure line art.
